title: Rotating Detonation Engine (RDE) -- Dynamics and Bifurcations
summary: Nathan Kutz presents the spatio-temporal dynamics of rotating detonation rocket engines, including combustion fronts that behave like solitons. He shows a bifurcation analysis of a multiscale model that captures the main features.
why: HN commenters recommend it for its fluid dynamics of detonation waves and its high-speed imaging of rotating pulses.

quote.text: you can still enjoy the pretty damn cool high speed imaging of the detonation waves in this type of engine
